brief: Five fresh modern Klay icon proposals focused on digital sculpting. Sessions is not a reference for this round. These are independent new generations, not edits of the previous icons.
method: Built-in image_gen tool; one generation per concept.

concepts.name: Gouge
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one modern desktop application icon proposal for Klay, a professional digital sculpting application.
Art direction: excellent contemporary 3D icon design with a sculptor's understanding of form and negative space. Sculpting must be apparent from the object, not from lettering. Purposeful broad shapes and a bold legible silhouette; restrained complexity so it still reads at 48px. Physically plausible matte material and beautifully controlled soft studio light, generous spatial depth without tiny fussy details. A designed CG icon, not a photograph of an object in a room. One single centered composition on a square canvas, subject occupying roughly 70-78% of the canvas with comfortable safe margins. Background fills the square continuously. Crisp finished edges.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no monogram, no label, no logo badge, no decorative UI, no sheet, no grid, no multiple variants, no border, no watermarks. No shiny plastic toy styling or generic corporate swoosh. Do not enclose the design in an additional dark rounded tile.
Primary subject: a chunky block of rich terracotta sculpting clay viewed in a restrained three-quarter view. A single confident loop-tool stroke has scooped a broad beautiful curved concave channel out of the top/front of the block; a short thick shaving of the same clay curls up along one edge of the cut. The cut and curled shaving must clearly read as subtractive sculpting, not a letter and not a bowl. Emphasize a silky smooth freshly cut surface contrasted with a few broad tool marks on the exterior. Strong compact silhouette, tactile and professionally crafted.
Color and backdrop: warm terracotta and apricot clay against an unbroken pale limestone / warm ivory background. Shape is the icon; a restrained grounding shadow only. Warm raking light reveals the freshly carved volume.

Primary subject: one striking abstract sculpture made from an uninterrupted thick folded ribbon of warm ivory clay. It rises into a compact upright asymmetric sculptural gesture, with one generous oval negative-space opening and a pinched turn that clearly feels shaped by a sculptor's hand. A beautiful sculptural object with broad smooth planes, one flowing spine, and weight in its base. Aim for a memorable silhouette that would be recognizable even as a flat shape, not an infinity symbol, not a letter, not a spiral logo. No separate pedestal.
Color and backdrop: luminous warm bone-white unglazed clay against a deep saturated petrol teal background, continuous full-frame. Soft directional light and restrained ambient occlusion reveal the turns and inner opening.

concepts.prompt:

Primary subject: a highly simplified sculptor's head-and-neck study in warm orange clay, viewed three-quarter facing slightly left. Crop the sculptural object at the lower neck; no torso, hands, pedestal or museum scene. One side of the face has a handful of broad, deliberate angular sculpting planes; the other side is smoothly finished, so the icon expresses the process of bringing a form to life. Features are reduced to a confident brow, nose and jaw silhouette with a simple recessed eye plane; no realistic eyeballs, pores, hair or portrait likeness. The object should look like a professional digital sculpture in progress, beautiful and contemporary rather than a historical statue.
Color and backdrop: matte burnt-orange clay on a soft muted pale periwinkle full-frame background. Clean directional lighting makes the planar-to-smooth transition visible. Bold head silhouette, premium sculpting application identity.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one modern desktop application icon proposal for Klay, a professional digital sculpting application.

Primary subject: a single compact mass of pale warm clay that began as a softly beveled cube and has been stretched upward and toward the upper right into one strong tapered sculptural crest, as if a digital sculpting Grab brush has pulled the surface. The body retains weight and a few crisp cubic planes at its base; the pulled crest is smooth, organic and slightly folded, with a broad scooped hollow at its root that makes the deformation unmistakable. This must be one continuous solid material, not a separate mountain, flame, animal or cloth. Express direct manipulation of 3D volume through the form itself. No cursor, brush icon, handles or wireframe.
Color and backdrop: luminous pale limestone / ivory clay against a clear modern saturated cobalt blue continuous background. Sculptural soft shadows, clean highlights and unmistakable asymmetric silhouette.

Primary subject: a bold, simplified sculptor's wire loop tool visibly making one generous curved scoop out of a compact rounded mass of terracotta clay. The recognizable oval loop and short beautifully proportioned handle sit diagonally across the upper edge of the clay form; show just enough shiny steel edge inside the loop to identify a carving tool, and a thick fresh clay curl lifting through it. Tool and clay read together as one compact emblem of the act of sculpting. Favor two or three large readable shapes over realism; do not add a collection of tools, chips or dust. Not a paintbrush, spoon, pen or pottery wheel.
Color and backdrop: earthy terracotta clay, a light natural wood handle, a restrained dark steel loop, against a light muted sage-green full-frame background. Fine studio lighting that separates the tool from the clay without overcomplicated detail.
